changeLog: Straker Beta 19.1: the chat is a small box in the bottom left of the map that opens into a chat panel nestled in the corner, framed in your player colour, with a red unread badge. The chat also works in battle, comes back when you load a saved game, and has more options: text size, a glass or solid panel, a sound for new lines, and hiding the game's own lines. Players who play together should all update.
